covered_sections: PDF 1 and 5–28: identity, abstract, nuclear shapes, rotation and electromagnetic rates
PDF 29–53: JUROGAM, RITU, GREAT, recoil tagging, DD decay curves and side feeding
PDF 54–77: 174Pt and 175Pt spectroscopy, lifetimes, TRS and triaxial alternatives
PDF 78–105: 175Au identification and lifetimes, interpretations and bibliography
comparison_coverage: APS Phys. Rev. C 84, 051302(R), PDF 1–4, shares thesis 175Au acquisition. Angular rings are separate views of one run. Platinum analysis remains attached to the thesis.
remaining: The published 175Au 13/2+ row labels 997 keV while thesis and PRC prose give 977 keV. The B(E1) table upper bound and narrative order remain separated.
The 174Pt 2+ and 4+ lifetime gap remains owing to unresolved 497/501-keV peaks. Absolute rate extraction and shape inference retain assumption and reading boundaries.
No re-fit of event data or author DDCM implementation was performed. The thesis denominator uses a printed speed times time derivative and the intensity index in Eq. 2.8 differs from its explanation.
